prompt:
Check one candidate model relation against sentences of a long engineering document. Unit ids show the order of the sentences in the document; the sentences come from different places.

Candidate: Sector Load Monitor provides "the Departure Fix Load Sheet" to Regional Flow Manager (an information or material flow).

Evidence sentences used to propose the candidate:
S483: The Departure Metering Service sequences recovered departures so that aircraft released from delayed turnarounds do not create a new surface queue at the runway holding points.
S484: Sector Load Monitor produces the Departure Fix Load Sheet when projected recovered departures require a consolidated view of demand by departure fix.
S597: Mixed-flow constraints are converted into paired measures so that departure metering does not protect one sector by creating an unmanaged arrival queue.
S598: The Regional Flow Manager uses the load sheet to confirm whether a departure fix constraint should be represented as an airport departure measure.

Other sentences of the same document that mention this item, a similarly named item, or another element that produces or sends such an item:
S722: If the Slot Allocation Engine is unavailable, the Slot Coordinator initiates manual slot procedures using a time-ordered control sheet maintained at the Contingency Operations Console.

Answer "supported" only if the document states that Sector Load Monitor produces or sends this item AND that Regional Flow Manager receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence), and no other sentence shows that the item Regional Flow Manager uses comes from a different producer or is a different item with a similar name. Answer "unsupported" if the sentences describe different items, the wrong elements, the opposite direction, or if another producer of the item the consumer uses is stated. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"supported","reason":"S484 states Sector Load Monitor produces the Departure Fix Load Sheet, S598 states Regional Flow Manager uses the load sheet (same item, shortened name), and no sentence names a different producer or a similarly named different item (S722 concerns an unrelated control sheet)."}
